Security First
Data privacy and security
Data is securely stored, encrypted, and executed in a dedicated, isolated sandbox environment for every chat. Apply row-level security to database connections for complete data isolation.
Your data is YOUR data. We never use your data to train AI models.
Your data is always private. Your files, data sources and conversations remain isolated, keeping your business information confidential.
Data is encrypted in-transit and at-rest
All data is stored and encrypted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), which meets 143 security standards and certifications. Data is safeguarded in transit with TLS and at rest through RDS AES-256 encryption.
Row-level security for your data
Control access at the row level. Each user only sees data they're authorized to access, ensuring complete data isolation between organizations.
